_published_faq.name: How do I add Turkish Airlines to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Turkish Airlines to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp-app.turkishtechlab.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: Is Turkish Airlines MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 15, 2026, Turkish Airlines scores 97/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan meets ChatGPT publishing checks and meets Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Turkish Airlines MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turkish Airlines provides these MCP tools: flight-status, flight-status-by-route, search_flights, search_inbound_flights, get_city_guide, get_airline_promotions, get_booking_details, and get_booking_baggage_allowance.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Turkish Airlines?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Turkish Airlines in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Turkish Airlines MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Turkish Airlines does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
Turkish Airlines is developed by Turkish Airlines. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
